description: On the tabletop in front of you are a dark cup, a purple-and-white toothbrush, and a small toothpaste tube with its cap nearby. The right hand holds the toothbrush over the table while the left hand lifts and angles the toothpaste tube toward the bristles, then squeezes to dispense toothpaste onto the brush and pulls the tube back as the right hand steadies the toothbrush.
